summary.text: Joan Bell, an independent, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Virginia's 4th Congressional District to Democratic incumbent Jennifer McClellan.
Ballotpedia lists no biography, prior offices or Candidate Connection survey response for her.

paragraphs.text: Bell qualified for the November 3, 2026 ballot as an independent; she is listed with no prior office and no reported campaign contributions as of Ballotpedia's latest campaign finance data.
She received 1.3% of the vote to Jennifer McClellan's 72.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
